page.overview:
Who is Erginus?

Erginus was the son of Klymenus and Boudeia. Though he is listed among the Argonauts his role is somewhat undefined. According to some authors Erginus was the Argonaut who piloted the Argo after Tiphys's death. This is questionable seeing as other sources claim Ankaeus replaiced Tiphys. The confusion is understandable since Ankaeus was one of Poseidon's sons and according to some sources list Erginus as the son of Poseidon.

Eitheer Klymenus & Boudeia or Poseidon & Boudeia
